title: Character classes
brief: Count vowels, consonants, digits and everything else, in upper or lower case. Print one line in exactly this form: vowels=2 consonants=3 digits=1 other=1
hints: [a-zA-Z] matches vowels too. When two rules match the same length, the earlier one wins.
So put the vowel rule first, and the general letter rule after it.
To catch everything else, including newlines, write .|\n as the last rule.
explanation: Every pattern here matches exactly one character, so all the matches are the same length and rule order decides. The vowel rule has to come before [a-zA-Z], or vowels would be counted as consonants.
